concerns.text: FR-002 and SC-002 propose using a *target‑permutation* test (shuffling the response variable) to assess whether interaction features add predictive value by comparing the Full Model to the Null Model. Target‑permutation destroys the true signal and cannot distinguish the contribution of interaction terms; it tests whether any model beats noise, not whether interactions improve performance over an otherwise identical model. A valid test should compare the paired performance of the two fitted models on the same held‑out data (e.g., a permutation of the interaction columns only, or a paired bootstrap/t-test on the RMSE differences). The current specification therefore employs an inappropriate statistical validation method for the core research claim.
